tracks.joseph-crawford-she-s-my-wife:
[00:16.22]Packed our bags, left the kids behind,
[00:19.23]Just me and you, a little us time.
[00:23.21]Headed out west, chasing a getaway,
[00:26.85]Niagara Falls was calling our names.
[00:30.16]We suited up in tan from head to toe,
[00:33.58]Two Frog Togg lovers, ready for the show.
[00:37.33]The guide pulled up with a grin on her face,
[00:40.93]Said, "You two planning to get wet today?"
[00:44.90]I said, "You bet, that's why we're here!"
[00:48.09]She laughed and said, "I've got news, my dear.
[00:51.83]The boats don't run this time of year,
[00:55.32]You're dressed for a splash, but there ain't one here!"
[00:59.42]Well, we might've missed that boat ride fun,
[01:02.52]But that sure didn't mean our night was done.
[01:05.95]Found some good food, had a few cold drinks,
[01:09.53]Hit the dance floor without a second thought to think.
[01:13.51]She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
[01:17.11]She's the reason everything feels right.
[01:20.32]Through the highs and lows, through wrong and right,
[01:24.51]She's the one I wanna hold every night.
[01:27.78]And when our time on this earth is through,
[01:31.11]I'll still be right there beside her too.
[01:34.72]When the world moves on and the stars go dark,
[01:38.37]I'll find her again, wherever ghosts are.
[01:45.88]She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
[01:49.80]And I'd choose her again a thousand times.
[01:56.66]We've traveled roads that weren't always smooth,
[01:59.87]Had our ups and downs, had some things to prove.
[02:03.62]But through every season, every twist and turn,
[02:06.93]She's the kind of love that never stops being worth the work.
[02:10.99]She's been beside me when I needed her most,
[02:14.39]The hand I reach for, the one I hold close.
[02:18.46]And if there's one thing I know is true,
[02:21.10]My favorite part of life is living it with you.
[02:25.35]She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
[02:28.95]She's the reason everything feels right.
[02:32.16]Through the highs and lows, through wrong and right,
[02:36.33]She's the one I wanna hold every night.
[02:39.55]And when our time on this earth is through,
[02:42.92]I'll still be right there beside her too.
[02:46.46]When the world moves on and the stars go dark,
[02:50.07]I'll find her again, wherever ghosts are.
[02:57.60]She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
[03:01.28]And I'd choose her again a thousand times.
[03:08.11]I don't need a mansion, don't need a crown,
[03:11.58]Don't need the whole world to be figured out.
[03:15.27]Just give me her hand and a little more time,
[03:18.82]A thousand tomorrows with her next to mine.
[03:22.90]And if forever means we never say goodbye,
[03:26.78]Then I'll love her beyond this lifetime.
[03:31.53]She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
[03:34.74]My once-in-a-lifetime, my reason why.
[03:38.54]Through every storm and every mile,
[03:41.90]I'd do it all again just to see her smile.
[03:45.60]And when these hearts stop beating someday,
[03:49.65]When this old world fades away,
[03:52.31]I'll find her again on the other side,
[03:56.02]Still holding her hand, still calling her mine.
[04:03.53]She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
[04:06.81]Even when we're ghosts, she'll be by my side.
[04:10.55]Through every lifetime, whatever comes true,
[04:13.79]I'd find my way back to her, like I always do.
[04:21.33]Two tan suits and a boat that wouldn't go,
[04:24.83]A night of dancing and nowhere else to go.
[04:28.71]Funny how the little things become our favorite memories...
[04:35.81]She's my WIFE...
[04:39.43]She's my LIFE...
[04:43.75]And she's my forever.
